sentences.en: In general, young people today are not interested in politics.
sentences.zh: 一般来说，现在的年轻人对政治不太感兴趣。

sentences.en: In general, people in America tend to prefer bigger cars.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，美国人倾向于更喜欢大一些的汽车。

sentences.en: The Party won a sweeping victory at the general election.
sentences.zh: 在 geral 选举中，党取得了压倒性的胜利。
